body.description: A combined-strike burst seen from the front: crossed white-gold sword slashes flash at the centre, then a ring-shaped shockwave of sharp white and gold light bursts outward and fades, with a few sparks flying off. Bright, punchy, about 0.6 seconds, no loop.
body.name: syn_offense

body.description: A protective shield wall flaring up: a translucent pale-cyan hexagonal energy barrier blooms up from the centre into a dome, its hex cells shimmering white at the edges, holds a moment, then breaks into glinting shards that fade. About 0.8 seconds, no loop.
body.name: syn_defense

body.description: A blitz of speed: jagged yellow-white lightning streaks and motion lines burst outward from the centre in all directions with crackling electric sparks, very fast, about 0.5 seconds, no loop.
body.name: syn_speed

body.description: Mending light: a soft column of warm golden-green light rises from the ground, with small glowing plus signs and sparkles drifting upward and gently fading. About 0.9 seconds, no loop.
body.name: syn_healing

body.description: A binding spell: a glowing violet runic circle snaps into place, chains of purple light lash inward from its edge and lock tight at the centre with a flash, then fade. About 0.8 seconds, no loop.
body.name: syn_control

body.description: The mother lode: a geyser of molten gold erupts straight up out of the ground, spraying glowing gold nuggets and coins and bright sparks, then splashes down. Gold, orange and white-hot, about 0.9 seconds, no loop.
body.name: dennis_lode

body.description: A searing hit: a red-hot chunk of metal slams into a target - a splash of molten orange metal, white-hot sparks and a puff of dark smoke. Small and quick, about 0.4 seconds, no loop.
body.name: dennis_sear

body.description: A huge painted rainbow brushstroke: a thick arc of wet paint is swept across from left to right in bands of red, orange, yellow, green, blue and purple, with paint splatters flicking off its edge. Hand-painted look, about 0.8 seconds, no loop.
body.name: capshun_rainbow

body.description: A coil of black fire: tongues of near-black flame with deep violet bodies and a thin hot-violet rim spiral upward in a tight coil, with a few small bright green sparks. Menacing, about 0.9 seconds, no loop.
body.name: apo_coil

body.description: An inferno: a roaring ring of orange and yellow flame erupts outward from the ground in all directions, with embers and black smoke rising. About 0.8 seconds, no loop.
body.name: ashur_inferno

body.description: A sunbeam: a focused column of blazing sunlight strikes straight down, a white-hot core inside a golden halo, short sun rays flaring round it, then it narrows and fades. About 0.6 seconds, no loop.
body.name: sky_sunbeam

body.description: A zap: a jagged blue-white lightning bolt cracks straight down from a small dark storm cloud at the top, with a bright flash and crackling sparks where it lands. About 0.4 seconds, no loop.
body.name: sky_zap

body.description: A shooting star: a five-pointed yellow star streaks from left to right leaving a sparkling golden trail, then bursts into little twinkling stars. About 0.5 seconds, no loop.
body.name: sky_star

body.description: A lullaby: soft pale-blue musical notes and little sleepy 'z' letters drift slowly upward and sway, with tiny twinkling sparkles, gently fading. Calm, about 1 second, no loop.
body.name: sky_lullaby

body.description: A gentle drizzle: soft rain falls from a small grey cloud at the top, small blue droplets landing with little splashes at the bottom. About 0.8 seconds, no loop.
body.name: sky_drizzle

body.description: The forecast, all at once: a swirling vortex where a blazing sun flare, a jagged lightning bolt, a shower of falling stars and a crescent moon spin together and burst outward in a bright flash. Big and dramatic, about 1 second, no loop.
body.name: sky_forecast

body.description: A retro 8-bit fireball: a round blocky orange-and-yellow fireball with a flickering tail, flying from left to right, classic NES style, chunky pixels, looping.
body.name: px_fireball

body.description: A retro power-up: a blinking rainbow-flashing invincibility star sparkle burst, classic 8-bit style, chunky pixels, flashing colours, about 0.6 seconds, no loop.
body.name: px_star

body.description: A retro heart pickup: little red 8-bit pixel hearts pop up and float upward with a white sparkle, classic NES style, about 0.6 seconds, no loop.
body.name: px_hearts

body.description: A retro sword beam: a white-and-cyan blocky sword-shaped energy beam flying from left to right and flashing, classic 8-bit adventure style, chunky pixels, looping.
body.name: px_beam

body.description: A retro 8-bit explosion: a chunky pixel explosion puff in white, yellow, orange and red that pops and breaks into squares, classic NES style, about 0.5 seconds, no loop.
body.name: px_boom

body.description: A retro coin burst: spinning 8-bit gold coins pop up and scatter with sparkles, classic NES style, about 0.6 seconds, no loop.
body.name: px_coin

body.description: Make it much bigger and brighter: the coil should fill the canvas, about 64 px tall, with thick violet-rimmed black flames clearly readable on a dark background and more green sparks.

body.description: Make the notes and z letters much bigger (8-12 px each), brighter pale blue and white, and more of them, so they read clearly at a glance.

body.description: Make the star much bigger (about 16 px across) with a thicker, brighter golden trail and a bigger sparkle burst at the end.
body.name: sky_star

body.description: Make the sword beam much bigger and bolder: a chunky white-and-cyan sword shape about 32 px long and 10 px tall, clearly a sword silhouette.
